resources.string: Optional Apple Music downloaded-library browsing for DX340 Remote. Reads library labels and clicks only the selected library item using accessible nodes. Requires screen on and unlocked. Tested app version is pinned; updates may require revalidation. Does not enter credentials, read protected download files, control other apps or use coordinate taps.

Optional Mango folder and existing-playlist browsing for DX340 Remote. Reads visible library labels and opens the selected folder, playlist or track through Mango. Requires screen on and unlocked; Mango version is pinned. Excludes playlist editing, Local Network, deletion, settings, credentials, private files and coordinate taps. Native Mango controls remain independent.
